definition.simple: Ribosomes are tiny factories inside the cell that build proteins.
definition.academic: A complex molecular machine found within all living cells that performs biological protein synthesis.

examples: Rough Endoplasmic Reticulum has ribosomes attached to it, making it look bumpy.

common_misconceptions: Ribosomes are surrounded by a membrane (they are non-membrane bound).
ai_context.tutor_hint: If proteins are the building blocks of the body, ask the student what machine inside the cell acts as the protein builder.
